observations: Photo 0 and photo 2: top of a white slim games console with a perforated round vent pattern, two controllers resting on it.
Photo 1: front of the console with a disc slot, a front USB port, and the Xbox logo on the front right; the shape and white perforated finish are the Xbox One S design.
Controllers: one white Xbox One controller with a 3.5mm jack and no share button, and one blue Xbox Series style controller with a share button and hybrid d-pad, fitted with blue thumbstick caps.
Console looks clean with light surface marks; the white controller shows some grime and wear on the grips.
Watermark 'KINGSPLEN GAMING GADGETS, POSTED ON JIJI', a dealer's watermark.
No photo of the console powered on, a TV screen, the back label (storage size, serial), power cable or HDMI cable.
No game disc or screen showing FC26 is in any photo.

identity.kind: Xbox One S console with 2 controllers
read_from: photo 1 Xbox logo on the console front
photo 1 disc slot and white perforated One S body
photo 0 and photo 2 Xbox logo on controllers

claims.evidence: Photos 0 to 2 show an Xbox One S console with disc drive; Xbox logo on the front in photo 1.
Two controllers shown in photos 0 to 2: one white Xbox One pad and one blue Xbox Series style pad.
Origin cannot be shown by photos.
Console exterior looks clean with only light marks in photos 0 to 2; working condition is a separate unproven point.

claims.claim: Comes with FC26 package and other games
claims.evidence: No disc, game library screen or TV display shown.
No clip of the console booting or controllers in use; priced as not working.

risks.risk: Console does not power on, overheats, or the disc drive does not read.
risks.proof: Clip of the console booting to the home screen on a TV, then loading a disc, with a handwritten code and date in shot.

risks.risk: Controllers have stick drift or dead buttons.
risks.proof: Clip of both controllers connected, moving through menus, sticks and buttons tested.

risks.risk: Storage is the smallest size, lowering value.
risks.proof: Photo of the back label or Settings storage screen showing capacity.

risks.risk: FC26 and other games are not included or are tied to the seller's account.
risks.proof: Clip of the game library on screen and the FC26 disc or a licence that stays with the console.

risks.risk: Power cable or HDMI cable missing.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: as console and pads only, no cables

risks.risk: Console still linked to an account or banned from Xbox Live.
risks.proof: Clip showing it signed out to a fresh profile and connecting online.

proof_requests: Clip of the console booting on a TV and both controllers working, with a handwritten code and today's date in shot.
Photo of the back label or storage settings screen showing capacity and serial.
Clip of a disc loading and the game library showing FC26.
Photo of all included cables and accessories.
response.reason: The console is an Xbox One S with disc drive and two controllers, shown clearly with the Xbox logo in photo 1, so it can be priced at its worst case as not working, smallest storage, without games. A boot clip, storage screen and game library would raise it.
